Hello! I really like your style a lot. I would like you to draw my OC like the reference image I have provided, but instead of a glass of beer, it's a can of Blueberry Acai Rockstar. The rest should be the same, such as the facial expression, the cigarette etc. I have also provided a reference to the outfit I'd like her to wear. Please also draw her without a hat.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1hFihoFQXMmn6TtT6XOdo-dVM_j6VyyfY?usp=sharing

Hello, I am looking for an illustration by Yowai! I love Yowai's illustrations and would like to commission him now!

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1nWZ2QxnHNv855BENasab2UnmYDxmH48y/view?usp=sharing
I would like to commission a child from the URL. I'll leave the composition, etc. to you!
Thank you very much!

Good evening! My name is Inami, and I am a Vsinger.

Thank you very much for your wonderful illustrations in the past...! I was secretly thinking that I would like to request your illustration again.... I have been secretly thinking that I would like to request your illustration again... so I have sent a request this time!

I would like to request you to draw a character for my live-action video.

Mikoto Inaba (boy with black bob)
He is a boy with black bobbed hair. Gender is male.
Height is about 153cm.

Brief description
I am a junior in a regular high school.
I post occult-related videos (such as tours of haunted places) on video-sharing websites.
I also do research on the ghosts that are prevalent in the modern world.

I apologize for the inconvenience, but please visit this URL for more information!
You are welcome to draw any costume you like.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1v1eXVI67i73FaJsaTbHnMZPaMXUgRyIe

https://lit.link/inamicord

Expression, composition, etc. will be left to us.

I would be very happy if you could create a somewhat eerie atmosphere reminiscent of occult boards, fashionable fears, or modern-day hauntings.
I would be very happy if you could give it a somewhat eerie atmosphere.

~ Intended use

Use on social networking sites
Use in youtube videos

We would like to use the image as a thumbnail for ghost videos, live-action videos, Twitter icons, etc., with full credit.
We would like to use the image as a thumbnail for a ghost video, live-action video, Twitter icon, etc. If you could provide us with a transparent background, it would be greatly appreciated.

I have always wanted to see your work in your style...! Thank you very much for your consideration.

こんにちはネムイ！私はあなたのアートワークが大好きで、あなたに依頼できることをとても光栄に思います! 可能であれば私のキャラクターであるリヴの絵をお願いしたいです！ 疲れたけれど幸せそうな表情を浮かべてもらいます。 タバコを吸いながら描いていただければ（お気に召さない場合は、アクションの選択はお任せします） 残りもあなた次第です。 ご清聴ありがとうございました！深く感謝します！
